Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3091); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites:--Jesus.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus is the name above every name, given before he was born. In Matthew 1:21 the angel tells Joseph to call his name Jesus, for he shall save his people from their sins, in Luke 2:21 the child is circumcised and his name is called Jesus, as the angel named him, and in John 14:6 Jesus himself says, I am the way, the truth, and the life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name says the whole gospel in one word: Jesus means the Lord saves, and he is the only way to the Father.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Angel Appears to Joseph
